title: CoCoOp image-conditioned Mirror prompt code
hypothesis: A two-value image-conditioned Givens code preserves CoCoOp base-to-novel accuracy with less generator state and provides value beyond an equal-width additive low-rank prompt conditioner.
physical_object: frozen openai/clip-vit-base-patch32 plus shared 4-token context and image-conditioned prompt generator
mirror_coordinate: m(x) in R^2 from frozen CLIP image feature, used as two paired Givens rotations on four prompt tokens
logical_multiplicity: per-image conditional text prompts for one base/novel classifier

development.selection_metric: base/novel accuracy, harmonic mean, prompt bytes, per-image prompt latency

storage.prompt_format: UTF-8 JSON header plus contiguous little-endian float32 arrays
storage.full_bundle_bytes: shared CLIP model/tokenizer/processor file bytes plus exact prompt/generator payload

success_gate: Mirror novel accuracy within 1 pp of CoCoOp; >=25% fewer prompt-generator bytes; >=1 pp better than matched rank-2 additive control at same updates.
failure_gate: Rank-2 additive control matches/beats Mirror, or Mirror misses CoCoOp quality tolerance.
final_decision_basis: Mirror matches the matched rank-2 additive control on base, novel and H-mean accuracy, violating the >=1pp Mirror-specific gate.
